response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform experience; their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang with minimal evidence of cloud compute leadership or distributed systems architecture at scale.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and domains
Demonstrated open-source contributions and technical mentoring through workshops
Proven ability to own and ship complex systems (e.g., GISCollective, AI-agent tooling)
concerns: Only minimal C++ exposure (LabWindows™/CVI role), far below 8-year requirement
No evidence of cloud compute platform leadership or large-scale distributed systems design
Lacks documented experience in technical leadership mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers
